title: THE THRASYMACHUS INCIDENT
about: A Ranger stops a State dinosaur with Thrasymachus' definition of justice, and the dinosaur agrees with him: one argument, taken at its word, from the stand-down through the lost jeep to the shared lie and Stryder's last verdict.

beats.text: An old interstate across the salt flats. A Ranger named Stryder drives a battered jeep, chased by a gang on dirt bikes. A radio star calls the chase live.
see: men riding motorcycles across the desert
a man talking into a radio microphone

beats.text: Hello, my gold-plated goblins! Ruby Rhod here, coming to you LIVE from the Audit of the Soul!
In a canyon of old oil billboards, something steps into the road. A dinosaur, wearing the seal of the State. Stryder slams the brakes.
Citizen-dinosaur! By authority of the Governor and the Board of Regents, stand down!
The dinosaur does not move. So the Ranger reaches for the one weapon he trusts: a megaphone, and an old argument from Plato's Republic.
see: a man speaking through a megaphone

beats.text: Okay. Fine. We’re doing this. Justice, according to the wise, is the advantage of the stronger!

beats.ask: is he trying to argue with it?

beats.text: Correct.
Correct?
I am stronger. Therefore, justice benefits me.
No, no, what I mean is, the stronger should protect the polis. The polis has… vibes.
Your vehicle contains fuel. Fuel is advantage. I will take the advantage.
That’s not— that’s not how—
It is exactly how you described it.

beats.ask: well, he walked right into that one

beats.text: BABY! He just got out-Plato’d by a reptile!
Wait! Plato also says reason should rule appetite!
My reason is hungry.
The dinosaur bites the front of the jeep clean off. Stryder rolls out into the dust, and the gang behind him cheers it like a lesson.
see: a crushed car in the desert

beats.text: Okay. Okay. You win. You’re the stronger. Congratulations on your… jurisprudence.
Thank you.
So this is what Thrasymachus meant.
Then a State drone floats down overhead with a recorded message. Dinosaurs are a noble lie. Please disperse calmly.
see: a small aircraft hovering in the sky

beats.text: The drone is lying.
Yeah. That’s kind of the point.
Then I will also lie.
…How?
I will tell the State I did not eat your jeep.

beats.ask: you can't believe everything they tell you

beats.text: LADIES AND GENTLEMEN, THE FIRST DINOSAUR TO DISCOVER PLAUSIBLE DENIABILITY!
It eats the rest of the jeep and walks off, dragging the frame. Stryder is alive only because the dinosaur won the argument and the lunch.
Justice… is expensive.
Clever.
